summary: Offensive bulk-mail / phishing / mailbox-checker toolkit (operator-driven, no installer-side harm)
details: monogrok ships a CLI (bin=monogrok) that packages bulk-SMTP sending, IMAP/POP3/EWS/OWA login checking against operator-supplied cookies, Shodan-based discovery of AWS SES / SendGrid / other MTAs, IP and proxy rotation, target-list extraction, and phishing redirect generation. All targets, SMTP credentials, mailbox cookies, and Shodan API keys are supplied by the operator through _init/ config files (e.g. _init/box/target.txt, _init/props/.smtp/{Aws,Sendgrid,Passgo}/) and are acted on only when the operator explicitly invokes the CLI. package.json declares no preinstall/install/postinstall/prepare lifecycle hooks, so npm install performs no automatic execution. Every source file is heavily obfuscated with javascript-obfuscator-style RC4 string arrays and hex-mangled identifiers, and the homepage points at mntmc.rip. There is no code path that reads installer-owned secret stores (~/.aws, ~/.ssh, ~/.npmrc, browser profiles), no hardcoded exfil sink receiving installer data, and no inbound backdoor into the installer's host — the offensive capability is directed exclusively at external targets the operator chooses at runtime.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
